lens.title: Lens Analytics
lens.summary: An internal platform using generative AI to turn client data and reports into actionable insights.
lens.decision: Full-stack product development and AI-layer integration through AWS Bedrock, collaborating with product teams and non-technical stakeholders.
lens.result: Reporting processes that took hours now generate insights in seconds.

requalify.title: Requalify
requalify.summary: Full-stack career reskilling platform: it analyzes the résumé with GPT-4 and generates, in real time, a career roadmap with courses, checkpoints and learning resources.
requalify.decision: Built as a team. Layered Java REST API with Spring Boot, authentication with Spring Security and JWT, PDF résumé upload and processing on the backend, and GPT-4 integration to generate the roadmaps, consumed in real time by a React Native app.
requalify.result: Presented to and approved by an academic panel at FIAP.

mottu.title: Motorcycle Rental API
mottu.summary: RESTful API to manage Mottu's fleet: users, motorcycles and rentals, tracking each contract's status and the fleet's availability.
mottu.decision: ASP.NET Core Web API with Entity Framework Core and Oracle Database, DTOs separating the domain from the API contracts, HATEOAS to navigate resources through response links, pagination for large volumes and interactive Swagger/OpenAPI docs.

bank.title: Bank System API
bank.summary: A banking API supporting account management, deposits, withdrawals, queries and PIX transfers protected by business rules.
bank.decision: Domain modeling, validation and transactional operations.

profile.title: About
stats: in reporting with generative AI at Lens Analytics
profile.lead: I’m a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building enterprise digital products for GM, Mastercard, Leroy Merlin, LATAM Airlines, Stellantis, L’Oréal and Diageo.
profile.body: At MRM McCann Worldgroup, I work in agile squads and currently build Lens Analytics, an internal generative AI product powered by AWS Bedrock that turns hours of manual reporting into insights delivered in seconds.

journeyItems.title: Software Engineer — MRM Brazil
points: Developed responsive, high-performance interfaces using React, Next.js and TypeScript for digital campaigns and platforms serving global brands (GM, Mastercard, Leroy Merlin, LATAM Airlines, Diageo).

Currently developing Lens Analytics, an internal analytics platform built with Next.js 15, TypeScript and MySQL, integrating AWS Bedrock (Claude) to enable natural language querying over marketing campaign data, replacing manual reporting for clients including Leroy Merlin, GM and Abbott.

Led front-end development of Dealer 4.0, an interactive vehicle configurator for the Blazer EV RS deployed at GM dealership events, built for TV-scale touchscreens, with full car customization, financing simulation and real-time 3D visualization.
Contributed to a large-scale government digital platform (PRODESP) using Adobe Experience Manager, delivering a CMS-driven system for enterprise content management.
Implemented scalable front-end architecture across 7+ brand campaigns, supporting digital experiences for millions of end users.
Work within cross-functional agile squads using Scrum, Jira and Bitbucket, consistently delivering on tight campaign timelines.

journeyItems.title: Java Architecture and Development — FIAP (Postgraduate program in progress)
points: Software architecture with Java and Spring Boot: Clean Architecture, SOLID and design patterns.
Automated testing, code quality and API security.
Containers, CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps and cloud deployment.

journeyItems.title: Systems Analysis and Development — FIAP
points: Programming and object-oriented design with Java, C# and Python.
Data modeling and relational databases with SQL and Oracle.
Web and mobile development, from REST APIs to React and React Native interfaces.
Software engineering: requirements, UML, agile methods and microservices.
Hands-on projects with partner companies, such as the FIAP x Mottu Challenge and Requalify.
